_doc: error-introduction rate per authoring agent, machine-wide, INITIAL DENIALS ONLY (owner orders 2026-09-21). v3: dynamic repo discovery; denials recovered from on-disk BLOCK artifacts (notary notes are overwrite semantics and lose remediation rounds); sub-program attribution from artifact file lists.
method: Episodes = every notarized commit in every repo carrying .adversary/reviews directly under a swept root (depth-1 discovery), plus archive reviews anchored '= commit <sha>'. Each on-disk BLOCK artifact attaches to the first notarized commit landing after its timestamp; only the FIRST BLOCK per commit counts (initial denial); CLEAR-only commits are zero-finding episodes. rate = findings / counted episodes (archive rows without a parseable 'new: N' are flagged no_count_line and excluded from the denominator). Attribution = git AUTHOR (caveat: repos driven via _git_do.py commit under the owner's identity, so their rows mix every agent).
